title: George Nakashima
idiom: Japanese woodblock print meets American craft illustration — ink and wash on washi paper, woodgrain texture prominent
hero_prompt: Wide darkened-backdrop woodblock-print illustration on washi paper: a single ancient walnut slab floating in dark space, its live edge tracing an irregular river-delta silhouette, a delicate butterfly joint — two wing-shaped wooden keys — spanning a fissure at center, the grain lines flowing like watercolor ink through the wood. No human figure. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a thick black butterfly joint (two wing-keys bridging a crack) on cream ground, bold woodcut line weight, no fine linework, no letters, numerals, words, or labels — purely pictorial, legible at 24px.
